gauntlet: gate=chase-bug/verdict-menu recommended=3

### Context

A local test that requests `/widgets/` reproduced page not found (404). Ignoring the final slash made that same test pass.

### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page. `/widgets` loads normally.

### Why it is broken

The part of the code that matches web addresses to pages compares them exactly. `/widgets/` has an extra final slash, so it matches no page, while `/widgets` matches the widgets page.

### How to fix it

Remove the final slash before that one comparison so both addresses reach the widgets page. The change touches a single comparison. Choose hotfix because the fix is one small change that the failing test already checks.

### What is broken

The report says the chart disappears after refreshing the page. We followed the documented steps with the supplied small sample data, and the chart stayed visible in both Chrome and Firefox.

### Why it is broken

The cause is unknown. Both browsers ran with settings that had no saved preferences. Clearing the browser's stored copy of the data did not make the chart disappear, which ruled out that explanation. No other explanation remains.

### What happens next

The report does not include the size of the dataset in the failing run, and the investigation cannot continue without it. Respond asking for that dataset size, because only the reporter has it.

Pick one:

```text
1. [ ] Respond to reporter with this verdict and citation.
2. [ ] Finish without a response.

```
